policy: Every entry was checked against the cited source on the 'verified_on' date. Numbers are never generated by the model. Entries are shown only for the region the user selects in Settings; the app never guesses a country from language. Re-verify before every release.

resources.name: National Emergency Service 999
resources.description: Toll-free national emergency line for police, fire service and ambulance. Callable from mobile and landline, including with zero balance.

resources.name: National Helpline Centre for Violence Against Women and Children (109)
resources.description: Toll-free, 24-hour helpline run under the Ministry of Women and Children Affairs. Provides information and referrals (legal, psychosocial, health). Press analyses report it mainly provides information rather than direct services.

resources.name: Emergency Response Support System (ERSS) 112
resources.description: National emergency number operated under the Ministry of Home Affairs for police, fire and medical emergencies.

resources.name: Women Helpline 181
resources.description: Toll-free 24x7 helpline of the Ministry of Women and Child Development for women in distress (emergency and non-emergency), linking callers to police, One Stop Centres, hospitals and legal services. Integrated with ERSS-112.

resources.name: Emergency services 999
resources.description: Call 999 if you are in immediate danger.

resources.name: National Domestic Abuse Helpline (run by Refuge)
resources.description: Free, confidential, 24-hour helpline for women experiencing domestic abuse and for people supporting them. Interpreters available.

resources.name: Emergency services 911
resources.description: Call 911 if you or someone else is in immediate danger.

resources.name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
resources.description: Call or text 988, or chat online, for support during a suicidal, mental-health or emotional crisis.

resources.name: National Domestic Violence Hotline
resources.description: Confidential support by phone (1-800-799-7233), by text (text START to 88788), or by online chat.
